title: CAISO: batteries and the evening peak
subtitle: Mean by hour of the day, 2026-10-17 to 2026-10-23; battery output below zero is charging
source_line: Source: CAISO, EIA via the Energy Research Warehouse (ERW), tables caiso_battery_storage, eia930_all_demand; data retrieved to 2026-10-25.
citations: California ISO (CAISO). Today's Outlook: batteries trend (storage.csv history). Via the Energy Research Warehouse (ERW), table `caiso_battery_storage`, ERW commit ba88d85d6094.

U.S. Energy Information Administration (EIA). Form EIA-930, Hourly Electric Grid Monitor: hourly demand, day-ahead demand forecast, net generation and interchange by balancing authority. Via the Energy Research Warehouse (ERW), table `eia930_all_demand`, ERW commit ba88d85d6094.
facts: CAISO, 2026-10-17 to 2026-10-23: mean demand peaked in the hour starting 14:00 Pacific at 29184.0 MW, when batteries delivered a mean -5675.54 MW; batteries delivered the most in the hour starting 18:00, 6956.52 MW, and charged hardest in the hour starting 12:00, -7283.08 MW.
Mean battery output 17:00 to 21:00 Pacific, 2026-10-18 to 2026-10-24: 5794.37 MW.
